aggressive.label: Aggressive — top 5, concentrated
aggressive.blurb: The five strongest trends in the halal universe, sized by inverse volatility. No sector limits, widest stops. Highest expected return and the hardest drawdowns.

balanced.label: Balanced — top 10, sector-capped
balanced.blurb: Ten names with no more than three from any one sector, so the sleeve can't quietly become an all-tech bet. Middle-of-the-road stops.

conservative.label: Conservative — top 15, low-volatility, sector-capped
conservative.blurb: Ranks only the calmest half of the universe, caps each sector at three names, holds cash rather than forcing picks when momentum is negative, and runs the tightest stops.
